method:
Build native asset-selection atlases and source room assemblies for the Drain.

All art begins as indexed GBA-size drawings. Enlargements use integer nearest
neighbour scaling. These source assemblies are not emulator screenshots; real
mGBA recordings are published separately by sewer_concept_review.py.

fixtures.label: Slimy gray bricks, puddles and floor grime
Gray retaining masonry and gold wall pipe
Forest ladder and unmistakable dark aperture
Gold wall outfall, bars, flowing fall and basin
Market, displayed wares and absentminded frog
Hooded purple wizard, staff flame and rug
Bridge linking banks across the sewage stream
Rail separating the player from flowing sewage
Small gold outfall pouring into moving water
Walkable floor drain with a clear barred surface
Lower rail, dirty coping, moss and moving water

indexed_geometry_sharing.meaning: Small blank or seam pieces can retain indexed geometry across concepts; palette color may still differ. No random pixel edits were added to force five unique hashes.
